_doc: Tier / entitlement table (SPEC_PET_DESIGNER_PLATFORM §5.1). Orthogonal to body type — a tier caps pose count + prices extra poses for ANY animal. Every number is an admin knob; none is load-bearing. `max_poses` is the per-user cap UNDER the platform ceiling (motion_profiles MAX_POSES=10); walk+idle are always included, so extra slots = max_poses - 2. `capability_tiers` maps a DPP launch capability string to a tier (data-driven, so the engine never branches on capability names); a launched user with none of these, and every standalone user, gets `default_tier`. `price_per_extra_pose` is surfaced in the UI and is the intended host charge (base credit_pet_design_cost + extra_poses * this), now LIVE via the host-side credit_pet_extra_pose_cost knob (§5.2). ⚠️ TESTING (2026-07-15): `plus.max_poses` is temporarily **10** — the platform ceiling (MAX_POSES) — so every offerable pose can be exercised while the redesigned designer is being tried out. **Set it back to 5 before launch**, or the launch posture below is a lie: `default_tier` is 'plus', so this number is what EVERY user currently gets, and at 50 credits per extra pose a 10-pose pet would charge 100 + 8×50 = 500. Note the practical cap is lower anyway — quadruped offers 6 poses (walk, idle, run, sleep, sit, eat), so a cat maxes out at 6 regardless of this number. LAUNCH POSTURE (the one-line lever = `default_tier`): default_tier is 'plus' for launch — EVERYONE gets up to 5 poses, and each pose beyond walk+idle is monetized at 50 credits immediately (charging works with no capability grant, since the host counts poses from the fetched bundle manifest). Capability-based differentiation activates LATER: (1) DatsMe grows a real premium capability (host known-capabilities list + partner manifest request + user grant), (2) map its string in `capability_tiers`, (3) flip `default_tier` back to 'base' — then free users get 2 poses and the mapped capability unlocks 5. All three are config/data, no code change. `pet_designer_plus` here is a placeholder capability key kept as the wiring example; nothing grants it yet, so it is inert until step (1)-(2) above.
